A swank [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] '''hotel''' operated business in [[Drev'starn]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the Bothan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. 

[[Unidentified crime syndicate courier|A crime syndicate courier]] and his [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Unidentified Rodian partner|partner]] used to stay in that hotel every time for a few days and was familiar to the staff. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]] however group of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[operative]]s stayed at the [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] at the same time while conducting a mission in Drev'starn. [[Unidentified courier lookalike|One of them]] looked very similar to the courrier, and the staff often confused the two and were accommodating. When the Rebel member pointed out their mistake, they thought it was part of some elabotrate plot, and ''acted'' accordingly.

When the confusion got out of hand, the Rebels tried to find out about it; even though the staff, as Bothans, were interested in conspiracies, were unable to clear it out. The confusion even brought the attention of the local police, and [[Unidentified Bothan police detective|a local detective]] met the Rebels at their ransacked room. It was then when they discovered the body of a Rodian hidden under a room service cart.
